title: Digital Knockoffs
abstract: arXiv:2611.28482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Social simulations often use language model agents to represent people who differ on several measurable traits. However, describing a trait profile in a prompt does not guarantee the agent will express each trait at its intended level. We propose a method that calibrates agents to multidimensional profiles using activation steering: (i) extract steering directions for each trait, (ii) learn a shared mapping from steering strengths to measured trait scores, and (iii) search for a steering intervention for each target. We use Bayesian optimization for this search and evaluate the method on the Big Five personality scores of 500 OpenPsychometrics respondents. In each of five rounds, the assigned interventions yield lower mean absolute error across respondents than the prompting and steering baselines. Further, the model's responses to a given intervention yield the same trait profile regardless of whose target motivated it, so a poor match

translated_abstract: 社会模拟通常使用语言模型代理来代表在多个可测量特质上各不相同的人。然而，仅仅在提示词中描述一个特质档案并不能保证代理会按照预期的水平表现出每种特质。我们提出了一种利用激活引导将代理校准到多维特质档案的方法：(i) 为每种特质提取引导方向，(ii) 学习从引导强度到测得特质分数的共享映射，(iii) 为每个目标搜索合适的引导干预。我们使用贝叶斯优化进行该搜索，并在500名OpenPsychometrics受访者的大五人格分数上对该方法进行评估。在五轮实验中的每一轮，所分配的干预在受访者上产生的平均绝对误差均低于提示词和引导基线方法。此外，模型对给定干预的响应无论由谁的目标驱动，都会产生相同的特质档案，因此（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于激活引导与贝叶斯优化的校准方法，使语言模型代理能精确匹配多维人格特质档案，在500名受访者的大五人格数据上误差低于提示词和传统引导基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an activation-steering calibration method with Bayesian optimization that enables language model agents to accurately express multidimensional trait profiles, achieving lower mean absolute error than prompting and steering baselines on Big Five personality data from 500 respondents.
